verdict.rationale: Filee documents e-book conversion from EPUB and other e-book formats to PDF, EPUB and Word. It also bundles Pandoc as an optional engine, which hints at broader markup support, but no evidence names Markdown, HTML or LaTeX as supported formats. Only the EPUB→DOCX slice of the story is evidenced. missing for 10: documented Markdown, HTML and LaTeX conversion, DOCX→EPUB or other reverse directions, a stated mapping of which formats the Pandoc engine handles, hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, markup and e-book formats (Markdown, HTML, LaTeX, EPUB, DOCX) convert between each other

citations.quote: EPUB, Kindle (MOBI, AZW, AZW3), FictionBook and comic archives (CBZ, CBR, CB7…) to PDF, EPUB, Word and more
Large engines are optional. Tick them in the installer or download them in the app later: FFmpeg, LibreOffice, Calibre, Ghostscript and Pandoc.
